General: Early intervention is critical for children showing any risk of dyslexia. Consistent, multisensory learning approaches have proven most effective.

PA_deficit.title: Phonemic Awareness Deficit Interventions
PA_deficit.description: The child struggles to hear, identify, and manipulate phonemes (the smallest units of sound).
exercises: Syllable Counting: Have the child clap out the number of syllables in familiar words (e.g., 'el-e-phant').
Rhyming Games: Use picture cards to match words that rhyme.
Phoneme Segmentation: Ask the child to say all the individual sounds in a word like 'cat' (/c/ /a/ /t/).

RAN_deficit.title: Rapid Automatized Naming Deficit Interventions
RAN_deficit.description: The child processes visual symbols slowly, leading to dysfluent and choppy reading.
exercises: Speed Drills: Use flashcards with colors, numbers, or letters and practice naming them as fast as possible.
Repeated Reading: Have the child read the same short, familiar text multiple times to build fluency.
Visual Tracking: Use a finger or a tracking card to guide the eyes smoothly across the page to prevent losing place.

Double_deficit.title: Double Deficit Interventions (PA + RAN)
Double_deficit.description: The child shows significant deficits in both phonological processing and rapid naming speed.
exercises: Orton-Gillingham Approach: Implement a highly structured, systematic, cumulative, and multisensory phonics approach.
Multisensory Spelling: Practice spelling words using sand trays, shaving cream, or textured letters.
Audio-Assisted Reading: Have the child listen to an audiobook while simultaneously tracking the text in a physical book.

Visual_primary.title: Visual Processing Interventions
Visual_primary.description: The child may reverse letters or struggle with the visual orientation of text.
exercises: Letter Discrimination: Circle target letters embedded in a sea of similar-looking distractors (e.g., finding all 'b's among 'd's).
Spatial Puzzles: Engage in activities like Tangrams or block patterns.
Line Isolation: Use a reading ruler or slotted card to expose only one line of text at a time.

Mixed_or_uncertain.title: Mixed or Uncertain Profile Recommendations
Mixed_or_uncertain.description: The screening shows a complex profile with indicators across multiple cognitive domains.
exercises: Broad Support: Implement a balanced approach covering both phonics and fluency exercises.
Differentiated Instruction: Tailor tasks to the child's specific strengths while providing scaffolds for weaker areas.
Professional Consultation: A full diagnostic evaluation by a specialized educational psychologist is strongly recommended.
